services.desc: Discover the beauty of Muskoka’s legendary lakes aboard our Campion R18. This versatile 18-foot Canadian-built runabout delivers the perfect mix of performance, comfort, and practicality for a memorable day on the water. Ideal for families, couples, or small groups, the Campion R18 offers responsive handling, a smooth ride, and enough power for cruising the Big Three (Muskoka, Rosseau, and Joseph), exploring quiet bays, or towing a tube. With comfortable seating, a practical layout, and a swim platform for easy water access, it’s ready for everything from relaxed afternoon outings and sunset cruises to active days of swimming and watersports. blurb: Northern Lakes Marine offers a large fleet of boat and Sea Doo rentals ranging from 14' aluminum fishing boats to luxury bowriders. Rentals include mooring lines, life jackets, bumpers, paddles, safety kit, fire extinguisher, and anchor. Free delivery is provided to many Muskoka lakes and surrounding areas with some delivery fees for farther locations.
